title: Estimated fill of the shared lock table

capacity.description: max_locks_per_transaction * (max_connections + max_prepared_transactions): the documented size of the lock table

tableEntries.description: Distinct lock tags in pg_locks that are not fast-path locks: entries in the shared lock table

fastPathLocks.description: Fast-path lock rows, held outside the shared table (at most 16 per backend)

estimatedFillRatio.description: tableEntries / capacity; an estimate, null when capacity is 0
